test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The window had been broken by the boy."

options.text: The boy has broken the window.
The boy is breaking the window.
The boy had broken the window.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action. In this case, "the boy" is the one who broke the window.
 
• The given passive sentence is: "The window had been broken by the boy."
 
• The sentence is in the **Past Perfect** tense (had + been + V3).
 
• To convert to active voice, we remove the auxiliary "been" and move the "doer" (the boy) to the subject position.
 
• The formula for Past Perfect Active is: **Subject + had + V3 + Object**.
 
• This results in: "The boy had broken the window."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The boy had broken the window."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The boy has broken the window." – Incorrect tense (Present Perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The boy is breaking the window." – Incorrect tense (Present Continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"The boy broke the window." – Incorrect tense (Simple Past).
